acceptanceCriteria: CEM-V1-227 in docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md agrees with protocol/cem-1.0/stable/tamper-matrix/EXPECTED.json (23 cases) or refers to EXPECTED.json instead of a literal count; REQUIREMENTS.tsv regenerated; doc gates green.
body: Residual from V1-1372 (PR #913, head 8d1a40dd5). The tamper-matrix README now matches EXPECTED.json (22 tampered copies, 23 cases including the clean map), but docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md CEM-V1-227 still states 20 cases. Expected: the spec states the count EXPECTED.json carries (or stops hard-coding it).
title: cem-stable-v1: CEM-V1-227 still says the tamper matrix has 20 cases (EXPECTED.json has 23)
